title: SelectField
summary: SelectField inherits the Select refresh: the field keeps its teal focused look while the list is open, rows are 4px-radius, and the selected check pops in. Its validation message now really fades in (150ms, 2px slide), matching TextField.
why: Task brief research summary (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria, Fluent): 'modern' here comes from connectedness and polish, not flashy motion. (Not re-researched in this pass.)

Connectedness: the trigger should read as part of its open panel. Measured before: while the list was open the Select trigger border was #E9EAEB with no glow, because Radix moves focus into the list and the focused look is keyed to `focus:`.
Concentric radii (inner radius = outer radius - padding): the panel is 8px with 4px padding, so rows should be 4px. Measured before: Select and Creatable rows 6px, Dropdown and SearchFilter rows 0px.
Selection feedback should be acknowledged briefly: the same fade + 85% to 100% scale as the v2 Checkbox tick, 180ms.

scenarioLabels.03-hover-row: Open, mouse hover on a row

motion.before: snaps back to grey as focus leaves the trigger

motion.after: 180ms, opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))

motion.before: opacity stayed 100% (fade cancelled by a utility-order bug)
motion.after: 200ms fade 0 to 100%, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))

motion.before: appeared instantly (fade/slide classes were cancelled by the same bug)
motion.after: 150ms fade 0 to 100% + 2px slide down, ease-out; reduced motion: 150ms fade only

states: Field / default / open: focused look while the list is open (also under hover)
Field / error / open: unchanged, stays red
Option row / selected: check enters with scale/fade
Validation text: enters with a 150ms fade
figmaSteps: Apply every Select step to the SelectField trigger and panel: State=Open = fill #FFFFFF, border 1px #27ABB8 (--color-secondary-600) + drop shadow x0 y0 blur 4 spread 0 #27ABB8 @ 40%, radius 8, height 40; Open + Error stays #F04438 + 0 0 4 0 #F04438 @ 40%; Disabled unchanged (#F5F5F5 fill, #E9EAEB border).
Option rows: corner radius 4, height 40, hover/highlight fill #F5F5F5, selected label 16/500 #484848 with a 16px #2BBCCA check 8px from the right (prototype: 180ms scale 85% + opacity 0% to 100%).
Search row (searchable): unchanged: search icon 16px #707070, input 16/400, 12px side padding, bottom border 1px #E9EAEB.
Validation message: unchanged geometry (12px #B42318, 4px below the field); prototype entrance: opacity 0 to 100% and y -2 to 0, 150ms ease-out.
notes: No source change in select-field.tsx itself: every visible change comes from select.tsx (SelectTrigger/SelectItem/SelectContent), except the validation-message motion which is one class change in select-field.tsx.
Panel scale/slide on the Radix Select panel: see the Select report notes (static translate-y-1 offset).

Found while verifying motion: `motion-safe:animate-in` is emitted after bare `fade-in-0`/`zoom-in-*` classes and resets --tw-enter-opacity/--tw-enter-scale to initial, so the panel fade and 98% zoom documented in V2-MOTION.md never ran in normal-motion mode (measured at t=0: opacity 1, no scale). Fixed here by prefixing those classes with `motion-safe:` (as Checkbox/TextField already do). The same bare pattern remains in dialog.tsx, toast.tsx, tabs.tsx, date-range-picker.tsx and date-time-picker.tsx (not in this task's files, not individually verified).
